LanguageData.LP_ACB_SteelCut.label: iron-cleaving form
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Immovable.label: immovable as a mountain
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Immovable.description: Immune to stuns, can't be downed, damage taken ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_SwordDomain.label: sword saint's domain
LanguageData.LP_ACB_SwordDomain.description: A sword aura covers 3 cells: every 0.5 seconds it resolves a melee attack on one enemy in range.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Warlord.label: lord of armies
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Warlord.description: Melee hit +15%, better shooting accuracy, damage dealt ×1.15, no mental breaks.
LanguageData.LP_ACP_CloudBody.label: cloud body
LanguageData.LP_ACP_CloudBody.description: Arcanum passive: movement ×1.3, immune to stuns.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Chained.label: chains of heaven's punishment
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Chained.description: Bound by holy chains: can barely move; each attack it makes recoils through the chains, dealing holy damage to itself (value by severity).
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Shield.label: radiant shield
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Shield.description: A damage-absorbing shield; severity is the points it can still absorb.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Blinded.label: blinded
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Blinded.description: Blinded by holy light or magic; can barely see.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_HolyAura.label: holy aura
LanguageData.LP_ACB_HolyAura.description: Damage taken ×0.7; fiends and undead that attack you in melee are blinded for 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Angelic.label: celestial body
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Angelic.description: Angelic attendant: damage taken ×0.5, melee damage ×1.5.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Simulacrum.label: ice simulacrum
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Simulacrum.description: A simulacrum shaped from ice and snow by a wizard: only half the original's toughness (damage taken ×2).
LanguageData.LP_ACB_DragonForm.label: true dragon form
LanguageData.LP_ACB_DragonForm.description: Become a true dragon: fights with dragon claws and bites, melee damage × primal power, damage taken ×0.5, movement ×1.3; can't do fine work.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_ElementalForm.label: elemental avatar
LanguageData.LP_ACB_ElementalForm.description: Immune to fire, frost, lightning, electrical and acid damage; sorcerer spell damage ×1.3.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Unstoppable.label: unstoppable
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Enlarge.label: giant form
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Camouflage.label: natural camouflage
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Camouflage.description: Motionless and blending in with the surroundings: the next attack deals ×2 damage (removed after attacking or moving).
LanguageData.LP_ACB_EvolvedBeast.label: evolved beast companion
LanguageData.LP_ACB_EvolvedBeast.description: A ranger's beast companion: damage taken ×0.67 (equivalent to +50% health), melee damage ×1.3, movement ×1.1.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_HuntGodEye.label: eye of the hunt god
LanguageData.LP_ACB_HuntGodEye.description: Shooting accuracy greatly increased (almost always hits), ×1.5 damage against favored enemies.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Crippled.label: crippled
